message: Non-canonical hash "0x0123abcd": the DLL accepts it, but hashes are written as 8 hex digits with no `0x` prefix.
Non-canonical hash "0123abc": the DLL accepts it, but hashes are written as 8 hex digits with no `0x` prefix.
Invalid hash "0123abcg": the DLL rejects it (Hash parse error) and treats the key as missing.
Hash "0123456789abcdef" has more than 8 digits: a TextureOverride hash is 32-bit, so the DLL drops the high digits.
Signed hash "+1": the DLL accepts the sign, but hashes are written as 8 hex digits with no sign or `0x` prefix.
Signed hash "-1": the DLL accepts the sign (`-` wraps the value to `ffffffff…`), but hashes are written as 8 hex digits with no sign or `0x` prefix.
